title: NPCs, or the most annoying creatures in my city builder
author: Kiko_Production
selftext:
These are the residents of City Paradise. I’ve been spending a lot of time getting them to behave, and made a little montage about how that’s going.

I want their actions to make sense. They arrive by bus, move into homes, go for walks and visit shops. A shop with nobody working in it shouldn’t have customers walking through the door. Small things, but they matter when you stop building and just watch the city.

Then you get one guy standing in the middle of a path, and suddenly he’s the only thing you can look at. Getting this crowd to move around each other has been a pain. Speeding up time means making sure their movement, actions and animations still work together. These little shits keep finding new ways to need attention.

The models need work too. I started with reference images and Tripo 3D, then used ChatGPT and Claude to make variations. The clothing textures improved quite a bit. Hair still has weird gaps and scraps sticking out. My attempts at hats were a disaster.

Next I’ll try a more modular approach with the Tripo models: separate body parts, clothes, hairstyles and hats that I can swap and fix individually. I like how the residents look in motion, so hopefully I can clean them up without losing that.

Any advice on handling interchangeable hair and hats?
